asset_checks.title: Docling — Document Parsing for AI
instruction_observations: Quick Use installs the docling package with pip, constructs DocumentConverter, converts a local report.pdf, then exports the parsed document to Markdown.
The asset describes document parsing, layout/table extraction and OCR, with structured Markdown/JSON/document objects. It supplies neither a literature-comparison schema nor a ready editable matrix.
The only hydrated step has empty variables and expected_output fields; the files list is empty. No matrix attachment was present in this payload.
prerequisites_and_limits: Python environment with pip, package installation permission, and an accessible input document are needed for the shown code. The page does not specify a supported Python version, model-download/cache requirements, OCR setup or complete platform dependencies.
No parsing/model run, installation or output quality was tested. Descriptions of accuracy and under-two-minute setup are catalog claims, not measured results.
The empty dependency arrays and markdown-only installation/risk metadata describe the catalog package; they do not cancel the Python package/code requirements visible in Quick Use.
Markdown export does not establish reliable citation/page anchors, scholarly interpretation, cross-paper comparison or synthesis.
asset_checks.candidate_role: Optional parser when a reader needs machine-readable text from a selected document; human checks the source before putting findings into a matrix.
asset_checks.necessity_for_observed_intent: NOT_ESTABLISHED: the question authors already read papers; direct manual entry into an editable matrix requires no parser.

asset_checks.title: pandas — Powerful Data Analysis and Manipulation for Python
english_h1: pandas — Powerful Data Analysis and Manipulation for Python
instruction_observations: Quick Use installs pandas with pip; Python reads an existing data.csv, displays rows/statistics, and groups a category/value dataset.
Later examples clean/date-parse a sales table, merge products and export Parquet. The asset lists generic IO, grouping and reshaping capabilities.
It provides no literature-review blank, academic field schema, source-to-claim mapping, checked synthesis example or automatic reading-to-writing step.
The only hydrated step has empty variables and expected_output fields; the files list is empty. No matrix attachment was present in this payload.
prerequisites_and_limits: Python, pip/package installation and existing structured inputs with the expected column names are needed for the shown examples. Exact supported versions and optional Excel/Parquet dependencies are not established by this request.
A template seeker must not be required to write Python merely to obtain the blank. Sorting checked rows could also be done manually in a spreadsheet.

The sample missing-value deletion and string normalization are generic examples; they are not validated rules for scholarly notes. Preserve absent/unknown findings and source wording rather than silently dropping or changing evidence.
Empty dependency arrays and non-execution metadata do not demonstrate that running the examples needs no software, resources or file access. No installation/export or runtime verification occurred.
asset_checks.candidate_role: Optional processing of a reader's already checked structured rows; grouping/export could help a separate technical workflow.
asset_checks.necessity_for_observed_intent: NOT_ESTABLISHED: organizing an ordinary editable matrix does not require pandas, and grouping is not scholarly synthesis.

handoff_evaluation.plausible_technical_chain: Selected PDF -> Docling parsed text/table -> HUMAN reading, selection, source-anchored notes and original matrix rows -> optional pandas organization/export of those checked rows.
handoff_evaluation.unsupported_transition: Neither source turns extracted document structures into faithful paper digests, academic comparison or a justified synthesis. The human/editorial bridge is the substantive task; neither asset supplies the matrix.
handoff_evaluation.reject_forcing: Do not require Python, promise automated literature review, add a generic second backlink, or rename an extraction tutorial as a matrix template.
handoff_evaluation.reopening_condition: Only reconsider if a source-supported necessary combination serves the same observed matrix task and a real immediately editable original package can be independently checked. Do not expand the asset/topic search in this sidecar.
